classes.name: ex:MultiCreditContributor
classes.reason: At least two semantically distinct credit records. Different roles prove their distinctness; the name is shorthand and does not exclude repeated same-role credits.

classes.name: ex:ThreeCreditContributor
classes.reason: At least three distinct credit records; three different role fillers prove distinctness. Not exactly three roles or an exhaustive career description.

classes.name: ex:WriterDirector
classes.reason: A person with both directing and writing credits in this dataset; classification is never manually asserted.

properties.name: ex:hasContribution
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: dbo:occupation links a PersonFunction, not a film-credit record. The local property refers to n-ary source credits.

properties.name: ex:contributionBy
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: dbo:director/writer/starring refer from Work/Film to people; this relation originates from a credit record, so they are not semantically interchangeable.

properties.name: ex:contributionTo
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: The domain is a credit association, not an Agent or Work. This is the film endpoint of the n-ary model.

properties.name: ex:contributionOf
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Inverse of the film endpoint of the local n-ary association; not a Film-to-Person relation.

properties.name: ex:hasRole
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: dbo:role and dbo:artistFunction have string ranges; the controlled-role entity of a functional credit record has distinct object semantics.

properties.name: ex:contributedTo
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Covers every collected credit role through a shared chain. director/starring/writer/producer are narrower and opposite-direction properties.

properties.name: ex:directed
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Inverse of dbo:director; cannot reuse that forward predicate with its arguments reversed. It is also a subproperty of the broader local contributedTo.

properties.name: ex:actedIn
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Inverse of dbo:starring; forward dbo:starring cannot denote the reversed relation.

properties.name: ex:productionOf
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Inverse of dbo:productionCompany; preserving direction is necessary for semantic equivalence.

properties.name: ex:sourceSnapshot
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: More specific than prov:wasDerivedFrom: points to a locally saved response record with retrieval timestamp and content hash, not merely any source entity.

properties.name: dbo:runtime
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Same relation/value semantics as the checked DBpedia property, with its original domain and range. Runtime is converted to the reference unit of seconds.

properties.name: ex:releaseYear
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Derived earliest-release-year integer summary from P577. dbo:releaseDate requires a date; dbo:year is a generic gYear and does not express the earliest-release summary. No equivalence or invented full date is asserted.

properties.name: ex:sourceUrl
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Literal lexical request endpoint stored in the snapshot manifest. DBpedia has no matching request-metadata datatype property in the checked vocabulary; prov:wasDerivedFrom is separately retained as an IRI relation.

properties.name: ex:retrievedAt
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: Retrieval instant of a local response snapshot, not a film releaseDate, generic date, or creation time of the original remote entity.

properties.name: ex:sha256
properties.semantic_reuse_reason: SHA-256 checksum of the exact crawled response bytes, not a generic title, name, code or identifier of the represented film/person.
